Part B-TI: 12a must equal Part B plus Part CA & D of Schedule VI-A.

Liable to pay AMT u/s 115JC — Form 29C should be filed.
Deduction u/s 80JJAA is claimed — Form 10DA is required.
Deduction u/s 10AA is claimed — Form 56F should be filed.
